dataset.name: chap-core example data: laos_pulled_data
dataset.description: Weekly suspected dengue cases per province for Laos (18 provinces, 52 weeks), pulled from a Lao DHIS2 instance, from chap-core example_data.
dataset.notes: Pulled from a DHIS2 instance with the chap-core DHIS2 interface (April 2024): analytics request for data element 'IDS - Dengue Fever (Suspected cases)' (wryMP8p8k1C), org unit level qpXLDdXT3po (code comment: 'each 17 Laos provinces'), period LAST_52_WEEKS. The DHIS2 base URL is not recorded. Locations are DHIS2 org unit UIDs; the geojson names them '01 Vientiane Capital', '02 Phongsali', ... (18 provinces). No climate or population columns. Geojson copied from small_laos_data_with_polygons.geojson (ids in properties.id). Dropped the pandas index column (first, unnamed) from the source file; otherwise unchanged. Completed the location x week grid; missing weeks have empty disease_cases. The source has no zero values (minimum 1); DHIS2 analytics omits zeros, so many of the empty weeks are probably zero cases, not missing reports.
dataset.schema_status: filled from source code/docs and data checks; not independently verified

source.notes: Period ids as returned by DHIS2 (2023W16 to 2024W15 = LAST_52_WEEKS at pull time).

fields.name: disease_cases
fields.description: Suspected dengue cases reported per province and week (DHIS2 data element 'IDS - Dengue Fever (Suspected cases)').

source.notes: chap-core climate_health/dhis2_interface/ChapProgram.py and json_parsing.parse_disease_data (commit c0b483c5 and before).

fields.name: location
fields.description: DHIS2 org unit UID of the province.

source.notes: All 18 UIDs are ids in the geojson (properties.id).

fields.name: week_id
fields.description: Integer sort key for the week: year * 53 + week number (e.g. 2023W16 -> 107235).

source.notes: chap-core dhis2_interface/json_parsing._get_week_id: int(year) * 53 + int(week); holds for all rows.
